integrity: Universal statements are proved analytically; the finite decimal checker is corroborative, not exhaustive. No independent scientific audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Standard full-dimensional partial alternating-sign-matrix polytopes, m,n>=2, in the Frobenius metric only. The complete center locus is specified by explicit inequalities and affine equations, but its face lattice is not enumerated. Indexed searches and two primary full-text inspections cannot exclude unindexed equivalents.
title: Euclidean inball centers and universal facet contacts of partial alternating-sign-matrix polytopes
